identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC policy] Permit audited gh break-glass during confirmed typed regressions

values.goal: Prevent confirmed typed GitHub-owner regressions from indefinitely blocking delivery while preserving typed authority through a narrowly audited and reconcilable raw-gh transport exception.
values.required_outcome: #418 is merged and terminally finished with a narrow audited raw-gh transport exception that cannot silently replace typed lifecycle authority.
declared_scope: Root operator contract for audited raw-gh break-glass transport.
Session coordination details for immutable receipt and typed reconciliation ownership.
authority_boundary: Typed C-SDLC v2 remains default authority and no raw gh exception may be used before merge.
No mutation to #414, #268, #269, AWS, or unrelated lifecycle state.

Only the six canonical argv shapes are allowed; no issue create, merge, close, finish, cleanup, delete, force, administrative, secret, release, workflow, API, alias, extension, extra-flag, or bulk raw gh operation.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle for #418.
Implement only in a bound FastWork worktree.
Obtain fresh independent design and exact-head implementation reviews.
Publish, merge, finish, and clean #418 without invoking the proposed exception.
